clues.it: Giada era accanto a un'ancora o a un barile.
clues.en: Giada was beside an anchor or a barrel.

clues.it: Ugo era accanto a una cassa o a un salvagente.
clues.en: Ugo was beside a crate or a life ring.

clues.it: Dario era accanto a una sedia.
LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Anna era da sola sul Ponte.
clues.en: Anna was alone on the Deck.

steps.it: Solo Giada può stare nella 1ª riga: per tutti gli altri è esclusa, quindi la casella in colonna 2ª è sua.
steps.en: Giada is the only one who can be in the 1st row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 2nd is theirs.

steps.en: Ugo is the only one who can be in the 2nd row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 3rd is theirs.

steps.it: L'indizio di Anna più le righe e le colonne già occupate lasciano una sola casella: riga 6ª, colonna 1ª.
steps.en: Anna's clue plus the rows and columns already taken leave a single square: row 6th, column 1st.
